name: mips_linux
statement: A user-mode process of a foreign platform: a MIPS32 (or Allegrex) CPU from the instruction cards, one flat address space, and Linux/MIPS o32 system calls from the os card. The host (cardmodel/machine/process.py) loads an ELF executable into it and drains its output; `run(n)` executes up to n instructions. Any fault (bad address, reserved instruction, BREAK, an unhandled trap or overflow) stops the process with the cause, never silently.
